title: 72 GENERIC PROPERTIES OF THE ARCHANALOGON 'CAVE' AND ITS ANALOGS

lists.name: Cave Analogs (continued)
items: Plant vascular system (e.g.öphloem, xylem, or leaf venation)
Plumes (penetrating the crust, mantle, even core?)
Pore space in a stone or brick
Respiratory system (nasal, oral, pharyngeal, tracheal, bronchial, alveolar, etc)
Volcano substructure (dikes, sills, laccoliths, magma chambers, etc)

lists.name: 72 GENERIC PROPERTIES OF THE ARCHANALOGON 'CAVE' AND ITS ANALOGS
items: 6. Branched ([with or of] graph-theoretic nodes and links).
7. Centraxial (possessed of backbone or main central axis).
8. Chambered, with swellings or pinchings, moniliform, or sequential.
9. Contains, develops, or entraps [breakdown or breccia, wastes, deposits, sediments, sedimentary strata, in-fill, sandbars, allocthonous material, e/vc].

notes: The first list appears to be a continuation of a previous list of analogs. Item 9 of the second list ends with 'e/vc]' which is transcribed verbatim but might be a typo for 'etc]'.
